title: Autism Diagnoses Rose Nearly Fivefold Since 2000
hook: Diagnosis prevalence reached 32.2 among every thousand children.
closing: Broader screening changes who gets counted, so rising diagnoses need careful interpretation.
question: Has screening changed near you?

segments.say: Autism prevalence reached 32.2 per thousand children, reflecting much broader identification than before.
Boys' measured prevalence was 49.2 per thousand, showing diagnosis patterns remain sharply uneven.
One site measured 52.6 per thousand, showing location and screening practices can change the reported rate.
